text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Pendidikan

(Penggal Institusi Pendidikan Kalendar Akademik 2025/2026) 2024.

Pemakaian

2. Peraturan-Peraturan ini hendaklah terpakai bagi kehadiran di institusi

pendidikan kecuali di sekolah swasta, sekolah ekspatriat dan sekolah antarabangsa bagi

kalendar akademik 2025/2026.

Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan

3. Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan bagi kalendar akademik 2025/2026 adalah

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Kumpulan A

Semua institusi pendidikan di Johor,

Kedah, Kelantan dan Terengganu

Penggal Pertama

16 Februari 2025 hingga 28 Mei 2025

Penggal Kedua

10 Jun 2025 hingga 11 September 2025

Penggal Ketiga

21 September 2025 hingga 18 Disember 2025

Kumpulan B

Semua institusi pendidikan di

Melaka, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang,

Perak, Perlis, Pulau Pinang,

Sabah, Sarawak, Selangor, Wilayah

Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur,

Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan dan

Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya

Penggal Pertama

17 Februari 2025 hingga 28 Mei 2025

 Penggal Kedua

10 Jun 2025 hingga 12 September 2025

Penggal Ketiga

22 September 2025 hingga 19 Disember 2025

Dibuat 27 September 2024

[KPM.PUU.S.100-1/19/8(48); PN(PU2)569/JLD.15]

 FADHLINA BINTI SIDEK

 Menteri Pendidikan

EDUCATION ACT 1996

EDUCATION (TERMS OF EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS

ACADEMIC CALENDAR 2025/2026) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 130(2)(b) of the

Education Act 1996 [Act 550], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Education (Terms of Educational

Institutions Academic Calendar 2025/2026) Regulations 2024.

Application

2. These Regulations shall apply to attendance at educational institutions except

at private schools, expatriate schools and international schools for the academic

calendar 2025/2026.

Duration of terms of educational institutions

3. The duration of terms of educational institutions for the academic

calendar 2025/2026 shall be as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Group A

All educational institutions in Johore,

Kedah, Kelantan and Terengganu

First Term

16 February 2025 to 28 May 2025

Second Term

10 June 2025 to 11 September 2025

Third Term

21 September 2025 to 18 December 2025

Group B

All educational institutions in

Malacca, Negeri Sembilan, Pahang,

Perak, Perlis, Penang, Sabah, Sarawak,

Selangor, Federal Territory of

Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of

Labuan and Federal Territory of

Putrajaya

First Term

17 February 2025 to 28 May 2025

Second Term

10 June 2025 to 12 September 2025

Third Term

22 September 2025 to 19 December 2025

Made 27 September 2024

[KPM.PUU.S.100-1/19/8(48); PN(PU2)569/JLD.15]

 FADHLINA BINTI SIDEK

 Minister of Education
